source: client tooltip function _5544 (study/game_r.js) run on every entry of the client item table _5465 in the inert vm; label = tooltip icon name (_2493 table)

label_rules.damage-tamer / damage-animal / damage-bu: _4564 (or the skill/projectile _4799/_5560/_5562) -> tamer; animal = floor(_5563 * dmg); building = _5569 (shown when > 0, 'repair' when < 0)
label_rules.damage: single damage value when _5563 == 1 and the item is not a structure-type (_5568 == 255)
label_rules.speed: floor(100 * _5581) = move speed percent while held
label_rules.reload: (reload + _1520) ms if both, else reload / _1520 / _5582, shown in seconds
